# Largest display of origami dolphins
![Largest display of origami dolphins](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/css/gwr-ph.jpg)

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://journey.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact/s/?language=en_GB) [ Apply Now ](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/account/application/begin/15-556524) Who
    Charles Violin What
     2701 total number  Where
     Canada (Hamilton)  When
     29 March 2026 
The largest display of origami dolphins is 2,701, and was achieved by Charles Violin (Canada) in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada, on 29 March 2026.
Charles has always wanted a Guinness World Records title and knew this would be a fun record to attempt.
His total (2,701) is the product of two prime numbers and combines this attempt with his love of math.
